summary: Narrow steep lane with houses 9-12 m away and nowhere to pull off.
reasons: Houses 9-12 m away along most of it
Narrow lane, kerb to bush and fences

drivers.seclusion: Detached houses 9-12 m away on both sides; only the uphill bush edge is clear.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed lane with dense trees and fences close to the edge; no pull-off wider than a van seen.
drivers.traffic: Quiet dead-end street with a few parked cars.
drivers.convention: A few residents' cars park along it; no sign of overnight stays.

flags: Steep: about 4-5% at best, up to 15% max
Witton Creek 29 m away, low-lying near the bend
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy over the lane, especially from the west and south.

best_section.where: West side of the lane, south of the first houses
